prompt.key: The password of the guest's user – a macOS build needs it once (sudo in the build VM, the base's user); it never goes into an image. Kept in the keychain: copy it from here whenever a guest asks.

help.key: Only for you – to tell your credentials apart in the lists and when building.

help.key: NixOS: the login user – the automatic login, the home folder /home/<user> and omaf ssh. macOS guests keep the base's user.

help.key: NixOS: the account's description and git's user.name. Not used in macOS guests.

help.key: NixOS: git's user.email; may stay empty. Not used in macOS guests.

intro.key: Who you are in a guest. NixOS guests take the user, full name and e-mail; macOS guests keep the base's user. The password – asked when you create it – is kept in the keychain for macOS builds and to copy whenever a guest asks.
